display_name: Tri 有标签与伪标签分类头梯度代理诊断
description: 十类与六源原始 E20 各 8 批，检验分类头 CE 代理对完整 L/U 方向的预测能力。
authorization: 用户要求优化 Tri 梯度冲突并详细记录；不改变当前 U 标签权限。

code.environment: N607 ordinary account, existing CVS-RFFI Python, CPU 2, FP32

data.dataset: original ten-class ManyRx and six-source receiver contracts
data.support_query_ref: not applicable; source-only, no target query

permissions.claim_scope: 16 dependent source snapshots, original E20 parameters and fresh AdamW moments only

checkpoint.initialization: matching original paper same-setting scratch E20
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: checked at execution: scratch, source-only, same seed and source contract
checkpoint.selection_rule: both user-requested settings, fixed seed and source offsets 0 through 7

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, two CPU threads; no GPU workers
execution.stop_rule: Stop diagnostic on identity, role, finite-value, derivative or guard-backward mismatch; do not affect other jobs.

expected_artifacts: 16 fixed source E20 batches with real-checkpoint no-query smoke
within-setting 56 ordered cross-batch CE head proxies and full L/U gradient relations per setting
for each L batch the highest and lowest proxy candidates and their full-gradient relations

metric_names: ordinary L CE versus native U pseudo-CE classification-head norm, dot and cosine
raw full L versus raw full U per-group norm, dot, cosine and top/bottom proxy comparisons
dimensions: eight fixed source batches per setting

rows.purpose: screen whether an accessible CE-head proxy predicts full L/U gradient alignment
rows.seed_notes: Fixed offsets 0 through 7 use CPU random seeds 2026092701+offset.
rows.scenario: source-only L and U; no target
rows.budget_ref: 16 original source batches, disposable CPU gradients and shadow steps

notes: No target, source V or U true labels are read; no training state is saved.
Same source-only E20 parameters but independent L128/U256 batches, augmentation and possible forward buffers; cross-batch pairs are dependent.
The U CE component is the native weighted pseudo-CE across ordinary, mixed/As and raw slots; L CE is ordinary identity CE.
This is a screening proxy over entire independently computed U256 batches, not a U64 candidate-pool training intervention; contrast and MixStyle cannot be inferred after recombination.
No later AdamW history, target performance, sample coverage or group-selection benefit is implied.
